# Pitch Deck Generator Skill for Muse

Builds a real PowerPoint pitch deck instead of just an outline: it interviews you to gather the company details, follows the classic 10-slide investor structure (problem statement through the funding ask), then generates an actual .pptx via a helper script with layout and design guidelines — backed by a reference guide covering fundraising best practices for seed rounds, sales pitches, and launch decks. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: generating the .pptx file itself requires `pip install python-pptx`; without that dependency the skill still works as a genuinely strong deck-content framework, but nothing gets generated. Content is in English. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
